description: Summarize JDK socket I/O from a .jfr (jdk.SocketRead, jdk.SocketWrite): event counts, total bytes read/written where available, top endpoints (host:port / address), and cumulative stack hotspots. Recording must include those events (custom .jfc or preset that enables them). If emptyEvents, use start_profiling settingsFile.

filepath.description: Path to .jfr. Shortcuts: new_profile, old_profile, or absolute path.

name: profile_jfr_network
